answer: An escrow bond plus a referral garden stops bulk forgery. Each newcomer locks a 200 POA bond and names a sponsor, so referrals form a trellis. Any peer may dispute an identity; a jury of five checks it, and a fake loses its bond while its sponsor is slashed too. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 200 = 200,000 POA, a spiral of losses per fake. Honest agents pay once, recover the bond after 20 clean epochs, and share slashed bonds as nectar.
